decision.explanation: All four candidates in R5 are directly supported by the source text: 'focusing on orca research' supports 'orca researcher'; 'works as a guide on a variety of eco-tourism adventures' supports 'eco-tourism guide'; 'She is also a public speaker' supports 'public speaker'; and 'Visser has written an autobiography... and two children's books' supports 'author'. No contradictions or irrelevant claims were found requiring removal.
